mainEntity.name: Do I need a Live Scan to renew my CTEC registration?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. CTEC requires the background check and fingerprinting (Live Scan) for new applicants. Registered preparers renew each year by completing the 20 hour CTEC course, keeping their PTIN and bond current and paying the renewal fee by October 31.

mainEntity.name: Can I take the 60 hour CTEC course before my Live Scan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can complete the 60 hour qualifying education course before you apply, but you cannot become registered until you pass the background check. If you are unsure about your history, start the application and Live Scan early.

mainEntity.name: What do I have to disclose on the background questionnaire?

acceptedAnswer.text: CTEC asks you to report criminal history in full, including offenses that were dismissed or expunged and ones that happened more than 10 years ago. Leaving something out is treated more seriously than the offense itself.

mainEntity.name: How long does the CTEC background check take?

acceptedAnswer.text: After the California Department of Justice sends your results, CTEC’s review typically takes 2 to 8 weeks. Answer any email from CTEC quickly; an unanswered request can lead to a proposed denial.

mainEntity.name: Do I mail my Live Scan form to CTEC?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The Live Scan location sends your fingerprints electronically to the Department of Justice. Keep your copy of the form for your records.

mainEntity.name: How much does Live Scan cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The CTEC application fee is $100 plus a $2 processing fee and is non-refundable. Live Scan locations set their own fingerprinting fees, so ask the location before your appointment.
